text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1578-626, 8 Inch UL Rated Surface Mounted Slide Bolt

The 8 Inch UL Listed Surface Bolt is extremely easy to install and comes packaged not only with all the mounting hardware you need, but also both a rim and a mortise strike. It also has a concealed mount. This surface slide bolt is made out of steel and has a brushed chrome finish. It is perfect for securing gates, doors, cabinets, and even window shutters.

Features of the Brushed Chrome 8" Surface Bolt:

  • UL Rated
  • Comes packaged with both rim and mortise strikes as well as a concealed mount.
  • Packaged with #10 x 1" MS and #10 x 1-1/4" SMS with plastic anchors.

Specifications of the Don-Jo 1578-626 Surface Door Bolt:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Chrome
  • Bolt Length: 8"
  • Bolt Width: 1.032"
  • Don-Jo 1578-626 Dimensions (PDF)
